content-unterminated-last-varint.why: the last byte of section 3 has its continuation bit set: the last varint runs off its list

content-unterminated-last-length.why: the last byte of section 1 has its continuation bit set

content-gap-past-count.why: the last posting's document equals the document count

content-listbytes-shifted.why: term 0's list bytes +1 and term 1's -1 (their sum unchanged)

content-listbytes-moved.why: term 6's list bytes +1 and term 7's -1 (both still >= df; sum unchanged)

content-listbytes-last-short.why: the last term's list bytes one short of section 3's end (a byte left over)

content-listbytes-last-extra.why: the last list holds a byte after its df postings (list bytes counts it)

content-df-zero.why: a term with df 0 and list bytes 0

content-df-zero-existing.why: term 1's df written as 0, posting count reduced to match the dfs

content-shared-short.why: a shared length one shorter than the true common prefix

content-shared-past-previous.why: a shared length one above the previous term's length

content-tf1-explicit.why: term 0's postings each with the low bit clear and an explicit tf (some tf 1)

content-flag1-flipped.why: flags bit 1 flipped (positions sections dropped when it was set)

content-overlong-length-varint.why: document 0's length as a two-byte (non-minimal) varint: not ruled out by the document
